text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking down the
hallway...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Doubling the academy's equipment, all
for the
sake of the Umamusume... Simply
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Agreed! Isn't it just? But that's only the
beginning!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear voices coming from a nearby room
and
decide to take a peek.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Declaration! I promise to turn this gym
into an
unparalleled center of sporting
excellence! I will
enlarge it by ten... no,
one hundred times!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
One hundred times... Amazing! Simply
amazing!
Only the director of the
esteemed Tracen
Academy would
undertake such a feat!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Shock! That Tazuna-esque interjection...
Oh, it's
you, Trainer
<username>!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Apologies! I got carried away by the
interview
and completely forgot about
the size of the
academy grounds!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... I'm at fault as well. I got a
little carried
away with the director's
love for Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
But the strength of that love is just a
part of what
makes her so amazing.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Could I trouble you for a comment?
From your
perspective as a trainer,
what's your opinion on
the director?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Anticipation! I would love to hear your
opinion!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Embarrassment! I feel rather bashful,
being
praised so frankly!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
But I still have a great deal of room to
grow.
There is still much to be done for
the Umamusume
of the world.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore! Please save the word
"respect" for
after I make the URA Finale
a success!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Inspirational! What a truly wonderful
person the
director is!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Even knowing she has the respect of her
trainers,
she refuses to compromise on
her own
improvement!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Clearly, she has no intention of stopping
until she
provides a stage where
Umamusume all over the
world can
shine! Simply amazing! I must write
about
this!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Permission granted! As Tracen Academy
spreads
its influence throughout the
globe, by all means,
document our every
move!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And you!
Trainer
<username>!
Let's
do our utmost to help every
Umamusume
shine!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the true spirit of Tracen Academy...
This will
make an amazing article!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the blink of an eye, I've gotten caught
in an
international scoop...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I'm so inspired by the director's
passion that I
go back to training
<chrname> with
renewed
enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Shocking! Tazuna does often warn me to think before I speak...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
But please, clemency! I assure you, I
only wish to
help our Umamusume
perform at their best in
races!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I see, so the director's erratic behavior is
all
because of her love for Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I-in other words, would you say you're
committed
to giving your students
whatever support they
need?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean you seek to care for
them not
only from birth to graduation,
but past their
retirement and into their
old age?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! I hereby swear to support the
lives of all
Umamusume! I do believe
that will make a
wonderful article!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: A-apologies! I got carried away again—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Director! What have you done now?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Eep! Abscond!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once again, Tazuna strictly warns the
director to
think before she speaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I'm so inspired by the director's
passion that I
go back to training
<chrname> with
renewed
enthusiasm.
